name: Grand Authority Plate
desc: A fine cuirass of dark, galvanised steel. The relative lightness of the chestplate, contrasted with its sturdiness and resistance to corrosion, make this piece a favourite among members of the Central Authority Shock Corps, especially among units which utilise hit-and-run precision strike tactics. Sellswords, mercenaries, and bandits of the Eastern Luminant tend to mimic this versatile style of armour using leather instead.
